title: Kacey Musgraves’ Rodeo-Inspired Stanley Collection Is Almost Sold Out: Here’s What’s Still Available
summary: The 'Dry Spell' singer's collaboration with Stanley includes three drinkware items for humans and one for pets.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Kacey Musgraves has teamed up with Stanley 1913 for her first-ever collaboration with the popular drinkware brand , launching a limited-edition collection inspired by the Western aesthetic of her latest album, Middle of Nowhere . The eight-time Grammy winner worked with Stanley to create four everyday essentials, including a tumbler, mug, water bottle and even a pet bowl, all wrapped in a premium cow-print finish that nods to her Texas roots. As with many of Stanley’s celebrity collaborations , demand was immediate, and several pieces sold out shortly after launch on July 14.

If you missed the initial drop, there are still two items available directly from Stanley.

FOR HOT OR COLD DRINKS

Kacey Musgraves x Stanley 1913 Classic Legendary Bottle

$55.00

Buy Now at stanley

The cow-print bottle is still in stock (as of this writing) and it features the leakproof, sweatproof, and drop-proof construction Stanley Cups are famous for.

The one-quart classic bottle pairs Stanley’s durable insulated design with an exclusive cow-print cover created for the collaboration. Made from recycled 18/8 stainless steel, it features double-wall vacuum insulation to keep drinks hot or cold for up to a full day. It’s dishwasher safe and ships in Stanley’s standard packaging. A Stanley water bottle clutch can be used alongside this product as a must-have for music festivals.

ESPECIALLY FOR PETS

Kacey Musgraves x Stanley 1913 Pet Bowl

$40.00

The 2-in-1 lid keeps your pet food fresh while traveling and flips over to serve as a non-slip base during mealtime.

A cute gift idea for music-loving pet-parents, Kacey Musgraves’ Stanley pet bowl is designed for travel and everyday use. The 24-oz everyday bowl is made from recycled stainless steel with double-wall insulation to help maintain food or water temperature. The bowl is stackable, dishwasher safe and nests with Stanley’s larger six-cup pet bowl ( available here for $40 ).

Where to Find Kacey Musgraves Stanley Cup Tumbler Online

While the sold-out 16-oz suburban mug and 40-oz Quencher tumbler are already out of stock from Musgraves’ Stanley 1913 collab, the latter has made its way to resale sites (albeit at marked-up prices).

THIRD-PARTY SELLER

Kacey Musgraves x Stanley 1913 Quencher ProTour Flip Straw Tumbler

Selling Fast

$148.00

Buy Now on StockX

StockX has several Kacey Musgraves Stanley Cups available online though you’ll pay a little more than the original retail price.

The 40-oz Quencher ProTour Flip Straw Tumbler features the collaboration’s same cow-print coating and your purchase includes an exclusive charm keychain featuring a tassel, medallion, star and miniature CD case. Other features include the iconic leakproof flip-straw lid, brown-colored handle and a cup holder-friendly design. If you prefer waiting for more stock at the original price, shoppers can click the “Notify Me” button on Stanley’s product page for the 40-oz tumbler and the 16-oz suburban mug though the site has not yet announced a restock date.

Musgraves’ Middle of Nowhere , was released on May 1, 2026 and topped three Billboard charts , including the Top Album Sales charts. The album features fan-favorite hits like “Dry Spell,” “I Believe In Ghosts” and “Loneliest Girl,” among others.
